node.title: Re: Pick k numbers at random
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
A quick Google search shows that this is a pretty well-covered topic, see e.g. [wp://Reservoir sampling]. On CPAN I see [mod://Algorithm::Numerical::Sample], plus maybe [mod://Math::Prime::Util]'s randperm, which is essentially the same as [Athanasius]'s [id://11108584|example] (although I suspect it might be a bit more efficient).

Update: Now with [doc://Benchmark]:

use warnings; use strict; use Math::Prime::Util qw/randperm/; use List::Util qw/shuffle/; use Benchmark qw/cmpthese/; my $N = 10; my $K = 5; cmpthese(-1, { mpu => sub { my @range = randperm($N, $K); }, shuf => sub { my @range = (shuffle 0 .. $N-1)[0 .. $K - 1]; }, }); __END__ Rate shuf mpu shuf 2496610/s -- -31% mpu 3598054/s 44% --
